name: Anpachi (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Anpachi town emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Anpachi, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Anpachi town emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised character
